# Morsø

Morsø is a Danish municipality (kommune) that appears in the AFDK 2024 report as part of the health cluster "Klynge VEST" (Cluster WEST) [^src1]. It is mentioned in a chapter documenting Indicator 8 (Structured Patient Education) of the AFDK program (Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark), administered by the Danish Clinical Quality Program (Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram) [^src1]. This chapter section presents a geographic overview of the Danish health clusters participating in the AFDK program, listing municipalities such as Morsø under their respective clusters [^src1].

The data available on Morsø is thin — it is mentioned only once in the corpus, as a listing under Klynge VEST, without further relationships, claims, or timeline events recorded [^src1].
